## What this repository manages

- Shell, Git, SSH, terminal, and editor configuration.
- Shared instructions, skills, hooks, and MCP registration for coding agents.
- Cross-platform bootstrap and upgrade automation.
- Always-on Mac mini operations, including backups and repository sync.
- Durable operational context under `agent_docs/`.
